title: AI vs copy trading humans
author: Mr_Hodlerr
selftext:
Earlier this week [I posted the data from all 9,470 copy trading vaults on Hyperliquid](https://www.reddit.com/r/CryptoCurrency/comments/1xmv5g2/following_the_1_copy_trader_for_6_months_turned) in r/CryptoCurrency: following the #1 vault for 6 months turned $10k into $237, while just holding BTC and ETH ended at $10,316.  
Most comments called it a casino. Someone put in $500, hit $700 in a week, then woke up to $20. So I went back into the data to see why copiers lose, then ran an experiment: what if you skip the human and let an AI trade instead?

**Why copiers lose**

\- **The leaderboard picks the riskiest traders**. The top 10 by 30 day return lost a median 49% over the next year, and none was still in the top 10. Before reaching the top, they had already fallen 53% from a high at some point. Big swings get you on the board, and the same swings come back.

\- **Money arrives after the run.** After a +40% week, vaults did a median -62% over the next 6 months. That's the $500 to $700 to $20 story in numbers.

\- **Switching makes it worse.** The same top 10 left alone for a year: $10k became $6,019. Re-picked every month: $691.



**The experiment: letting an AI trade instead**

Live AI vs copy trading humans battle- [botsfolio.com/battle/copy-trading-vs-ai](http://botsfolio.com/battle/copy-trading-vs-ai) (I have put it to real test, just started few days back on live market)

Every loss above comes from a human decision: picking the trader, joining after a hot week, switching to the next one. So I took those decisions away. The AI gets the same $10k on the same dates as the copiers and trades BTC and ETH on its own. You don't pick a trader, a coin or a moment to get in.

It also skips what hurt the copiers. It doesn't chase whoever is up most this month, doesn't pile in after a big week, and doesn't switch. It follows the same rules every day, in good markets and bad.

Results over 12 months from the same 16 start dates: the AI turned $10k into a median $11,255 and made money from all 16. Re-picking the top 10 traders: $691. Holding BTC and ETH: $8,682.

Against every vault that held $10k+, each on its own dates: the AI returned +32.4% and made money 99% of the time. The median vault returned -37.4%. The bigger gap was in the falls: a 20% worst drop for the AI, against 61% for the median vault. 15% of vaults beat its return.

Full copy trading report: [https://botsfolio.com/blog/does-copy-trading-work](https://botsfolio.com/blog/does-copy-trading-work)
